quotes.text: Grip the Dumbbell: Hold a single dumbbell with both hands. Your thumbs should wrap around the handle and fingers grip the body of the dumbbell.
quotes.closest: Grip the Dumbbell: Hold a single dumbbell with both hands. Your thumbs should wrap around the handle and fingers grip the body of the dumbbell.

quotes.text: Place your palms against the inside of the dumbbell head. The handle should run between your thumb and finger.
quotes.closest: Place your palms against the inside of the dumbbell head. The handle should run between your thumb and finger.

quotes.text: Hold the weight overhead by grasping the inside dumbbell plate surface with both hands, or by grasping both handles of the kettlebell.
quotes.closest: Hold the weight overhead by grasping the inside dumbbell plate surface with both hands, or by grasping both handles of the kettlebell.

quotes.text: Stand in a split-stance position holding a dumbbell with both hands and wrap both hands around the dumbbell handle.
quotes.closest: Stand in a split-stance position holding a dumbbell with both hands and wrap both hands around the dumbbell handle.

quotes.text: The dumbbell should be positioned directly over your head with your palms facing upwards and the dumbbell hanging vertically or angled slightly.
quotes.closest: The dumbbell should be positioned directly over your head with your palms facing upwards and the dumbbell hanging vertically or angled slightly.

quotes.text: Maintain your balance and avoid changing the position of your head, torso, upper arms, wrists and feet.
quotes.closest: Maintain your balance and avoid changing the position of your head, torso, upper arms, wrists and feet.
